dog.description_text:
Hi! Say hello to Tracker! This sweet boy is a bundle of joy! Tracker has a kind, loving personality. He loves to give a kiss and a hug to every one who wants to meet him. He is a very good listener. He understands when told to sit. It’s currently unknown how Tracker will be in a home with other dogs, cats, and/or kids. However, he has not shown aggressive actions towards other dogs on walks when he sees one. He is quiet and rarely barks inside. He does not bark outside. He enjoys sitting next to me on the bed or sofa during the day. When I leave a room, he follows. He prefers to be around others and isn’t yet used to being alone. Tracker enjoys sleeping beside me at night, but will understand when told to sleep in his crate. He has moments of high energy. When his energy is high he loves to play with his toys and go on walks to explore. He loves a good power walk! During his calm moments, he sits quietly or takes a nap. Tracker is still learning how to walk without pulling, but he is improving. He can get distracted by loud noises and birds on walks. He has done very well learning to use the potty outside. A walk schedule will continue to help avoid accidents. His appetite is normal, but he likes company when he eats. Tracker is a sweetheart and I hope you will consider being the one who gives him his forever home!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
